topic: Churn Prediction Modeling - Early Warning Signals

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Patricia, our board is pushing cost reduction across all vendors. I need to justify every expense, including our telecom costs.
transcript.churn_signals: Cost pressure, board mandate, expense justification required

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand the pressure to optimize costs. Let me pull your usage analytics and show you the ROI we're delivering. Have you gotten competitive quotes yet?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: We've had a few vendors reach out with lower pricing. I need to do my due diligence before renewal.
transcript.churn_signals: Competitive engagement, due diligence phase, renewal uncertainty

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely smart approach. Before you make any decisions, let me prepare a comprehensive value analysis showing cost per incident, uptime value, and total cost of ownership comparison.
